source.changes: Source facts paraphrased into decision scopes; implementation/evidence reconciliation and tracker ownership are Edda additions. No runtime grants.

common_acceptance: For this one PR, preview is inert; explicit confirmation revalidates authoritative eligibility, source/version, target facts and expected revision. Persist choice, exact dice, once-only cost/use and history atomically. Receipt replay/retry/reload returns the same result without rerolling or charging again. Inject history failure for full rollback; race two confirmations and require one commit; stale/foreign/unsupported state rejects without mutation. Prove this with deterministic dice and isolated PostgreSQL handler/state fixtures. Disclose only player-known targets, choices, costs and source derivations; hidden/foreign facts never enter previews, receipts or errors. Shared engine serves web and TUI: explicitly expose supported choices or show unavailable with a reason on both; require desktop/phone confirmation and reconnect plus TUI behavior fixtures before availability. No Full Rules/coverage promotion. Higher-level isolated fixture state never grants production entitlement. Run GOMAXPROCS=2 go test -p 2 -short -race ./... and go vet -p 2 ./...; changed UI requires build, focused lint and behavior tests.

### Bard decision and explicit qualification gate

Bard decision #322 publishes gate #501, shared terminal implementations #502–#506, Bard feature/choice adapters #507–#528, twenty admissions/transitions #529–#548, and later-class entry #549. All 48 new terminals and 38 reused terminals are mandatory native prerequisites of #501; #322 also blocks it. Gate #501 directly blocks #337. Each new shared terminal also directly blocks #279 and #280. GitHub's 100-blocker limit requires this explicit hierarchy; historical #334 source, body and direct-gate controls remain unchanged.

Bard-specific children are native children of #501, itself under #283; shared additions retain parents #191/#193. Dependencies and native containment are checked separately. Source/decision closure never enables playable Bard support, grants, coverage or Full Rules. Unsupported levels, effects, origins and mixed-class configurations fail closed. #322 remains open until its decision PR merges.

Shared owners: #427/#428 completed rests; #429 reusable XP/PB/CON transaction with #507 Bard d8/fixed-five adapter; #430 proficiency provenance; #487/#488 conditions; #384 selection/#389 ability caps/#399 Spell Recall. #502 consumes #273 casting modes (not sheet); #503/#505/#506 consume #277 spell ownership; #504 owns only trusted Paralyzed/Poisoned/Stunned ending. #58 remains the projection boundary. Existing owner bodies and parents are retained.

Exact scopes, source keys, native prerequisites and evidence: `docs/investigations/issue-322-bard-scope.json`; publication receipt: `issue-322-link-verification.json`; read-only validation: `python3 scripts/verify_bard_scope.py --live --probes --pdf /tmp/edda-wave1/SRD_CC_v5.2.1.pdf`.
<!-- edda-322:supplement:47:end -->

gate_body:
<!-- edda-322:qualification-gate -->
Parent: #283; decision #322; roadmap #47. Task Size M.

Qualify all Bard/Lore source features, choices, all20rows, first/later-class entry and shared prerequisite implementations listed in docs/investigations/issue-322-bard-scope.json. Every exact new and reused terminal plus decision #322 must be native blocked-by here; this gate directly blocks #337. The hierarchy is required by GitHub100-blocker capacity, preserves historical #334 direct edges, and never treats planning closure as feature execution.

Accept only source-linked deterministic positive/negative fixtures, inert preview/explicit confirmation, atomic choices/dice/cost/history, durable retry/reload/rollback/concurrency and web/TUI confirmation/reconnect/disclosure proof for every declared supported option. Unknown levels, origin/multiclass configurations, spell/item effects and prerequisites remain unavailable. No blanket Bard or Full Rules promotion from data/decision closure. Verify exact graph paths, source/evidence/body hashes, Task/Project sizes and acyclicity with scripts/verify_bard_scope.py before qualification. No deployment or inference.
native_hierarchy: Bard qualification gate parent283; Bard-specific terminals parent Bard gate; shared additions retain domain parent191/193. Required dependency paths exact terminal -> Bard gate ->337.
